page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.u2i-c1m1.2xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 8 dedicated Intel Xeon vCPUs running at a clock speed of 2.7 GHz. The instance is configured with 8.0 GB of system memory, yielding a resource density of 1.0 GB of RAM per vCPU.

This server type does not include local storage, requiring external block storage for persistent data. It also lacks any GPU acceleration, making it unsuitable for hardware-accelerated graphics or deep learning tasks. Network connectivity is provisioned with a baseline bandwidth of 5 Gbps, and the instance does not include complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

With a one-to-one ratio of vCPUs to memory, this instance is highly compute-heavy relative to its memory capacity. This configuration offers qualitative cost efficiency for workloads that require dedicated CPU cycles but have minimal memory footprints. It is suited for CPU-bound tasks such as light web serving, batch processing, and basic computational workloads that fit entirely within the 8.0 GB memory limit.
